conventions.buffers: Common ±0.005 shift of three momentum buffers, preserving their differences; no fitted weights
conventions.flatness: Distinct non-center neighbor configs only; ablations reported separately
conventions.min_hold: ±1, floor0, then normalize1→0 for once-daily decisions
conventions.no_new_gate: Report existing development gates and median/Q25 scores; never change the frozen primary
conventions.windows: Each window separately ±20%, and whole group ±20%; round, floor2, distinct windows
